new_libraries.name: Control_Led_Bus
new_libraries.author: Cedric
new_libraries.sentence: Pilotage de rubans LED adressables (RMT) sur ESP32, depuis une source DMX / Art-Net ou en mode manuel.
new_libraries.paragraph: StripLed pilote un ruban via RMT (show() non bloquant). CDmx et CArtnet recuperent les niveaux via DMX physique ou Art-Net, et StripDmx fait le lien entre une source (CSource) et plusieurs rubans avec lissage/snap/gamma. Le mode manuel (Preset, Effect, Select, ManualRender) joue couleurs fixes et effets sans source externe. esp_dmx est integre dans src/third_party, rien a installer a part.

new_libraries.name: TempestTCode
new_libraries.author: TempestMAx
new_libraries.sentence: TCode protocol parser and multi-axis motion library for DIY stroker devices.
new_libraries.paragraph: Implements TCode v0.4 command parsing, per-axis motion, and EEPROM/Preferences range save. Intended for OSR2, SR6, SSR1, SSR2 and other TCode-compatible firmware.

library.name: EspNowCam
library.author: @hpsaturn
library.sentence: ESPNowCam, a straightforward video streamer for popular ESP32Cam models, leveraging the ESPNow protocol. No need for IPs, routers, or credentials—keeping it simple! :D
library.paragraph: ESPNowCam supports ESP32 Cameras for give an easy video streamer from popular ESP32Cam models and it uses ESPNow protocol. No IP, No routers, No credentials. It has broadcast and P2P support. **This library is for general purpose**, as it receives pointers to data, such as buffers, strings, images, or any byte-formatted content. This versatility allows you to transmit larger packages. Tested on ESP32S3 cameras. Please visit my ESP32 Telegram channel https://t.me/esp_es and ask any doubt.
